protocol.draws: independent uniform draws; sigma1 and sigma2 are independent
protocol.reference: Whole-space analytic heat solution restricted to observation window; no zero or periodic PDE boundary imposed
protocol.input: 192 samples of the total mixture at t=0; no mixture parameters or component labels
protocol.future_scan: No future or prediction error used to choose displayed examples
protocol.name: ordinary_independent_two_gaussian_domain16_t10
protocol.data_reuse: Exact original seed71 parameters and 36/12/24 split, verified against independent-uniform generator

protocol.acceptance: All original ICs retained; no rejection, resampling, or shape filtering

initial_shape_audit.peak_definition: strict left and non-strict right local maximum on fine sampled initial field
initial_shape_audit.clear_bimodality_definition: two maxima, valley/smaller peak <=0.8, smaller/larger peak >=0.1
initial_shape_audit.example_selection_rule: Among clearly bimodal test initial fields, minimize valley/smaller peak; tie-break by greater peak separation then sample_id. If none are clear, use all bimodal initial fields.
